simple: An agentless cloud solution for administrator access to Windows and Linux servers, databases and Kubernetes clusters on premises and in the cloud (formerly CyberArk Dynamic Privileged Access). It follows the zero standing privileges model: an account, a group membership or a short-lived SSH certificate is created only for the duration of a task and disappears afterwards, so there is nothing to steal in advance. Connections with vaulted passwords are also possible. Administrators keep their usual RDP, SSH and database clients; sessions are isolated, recorded and land in a unified audit log. Sold as a per-user add-on to Idira Privileged Access Manager SaaS.
